note: The six K56FlexFloModem visual diagnostics against t_v34diag.  Three bytes each in the object, so the interesting claim is what they do NOT do: each mutation gives one of them a body that reports a point or writes through the array, which is what a stub must be shown not to do.  The two resampler ones are mutated on the ARRAY rather than on the return value, because the dispatcher discards their result and only a write is observable.

label: K56flex getConstellation reports a point
K56flex getLinearEqualizer reports a point
K56flex getDFE reports a point
K56flex getDecisionErrors reports a point
K56flex getResamplerPhase writes the point it is handed
K56flex getResamplerOffset writes the point it is handed
